plugins.name: iadc
plugins.description: The whole IADC suite in one install — advisory architect plus Selenium test generation. Contains no skills itself; installing it pulls in the others.

plugins.name: iadc-advisor
plugins.description: Advisory Appian architect: pressure-test tickets against the live app, produce build specs, answer how-does-our-app-work — advise and plan, never build.

plugins.name: iadc-tester
plugins.description: Sync an Appian application's Selenium test suite with a Jira ticket's requirements, scoped by the App Graph.

plugins.name: iadc-graph
plugins.description: Query an Appian application's App Graph over the IADC graph MCP. Installed automatically as a dependency of the advisor and the tester.
